description: Checked fixture pinning the Flint fabric auth/data contract that this repository's Flint adapter depends on. Facts verified against flint-gate crates/flint-gate-core/src/auth/{jwt_verify.rs,jwks.rs}, flint-forge crates/ext-flint-auth/sql/flint_auth.sql, flint-forge migrations 0013_force_rls.sql / 0014_service_role_bypassrls.sql, flint-forge crates/forge-cli/src/main.rs, and the FLINT_ANON_SERVICE_ROLE_KEYS_SPEC.md key-separation spec. This repo does NOT verify tokens itself; the identity plane is flint-gate.

issuer.rule: validated when an issuer is configured

audience.rule: validated when an audience is configured; validation disabled when none is configured

tenant.rule: tenant identity rides the channel envelope (channel.tenantId); subscriptions and mutations must carry tenantId + channelId

role.rule: maps to the Postgres role for the connection

jwks.unknownKidBehavior: forces at most one rate-limited JWKS refresh (MIN_REFRESH_INTERVAL), then re-checks
jwks.keySelection: asymmetric keys only; symmetric-downgrade / alg-confusion rejected
jwks.compatibilityCaveat: strict-JWK: clients MUST send a kid header matching a published JWK, and any JWKS consumer MUST NOT fall back to the first key when kid is absent

anon.exposure: publishable; safe for clients, gated by RLS

authenticated.exposure: end-user session tokens, gated by RLS

service_role.exposure: secret; server-side provisioning only, MUST never ship in client examples, bundles, logs, or evidence

rls.default: tables are RLS-governed; internal tables carry FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY (migration 0013)
rls.serviceRoleBypass: service_role holds a real BYPASSRLS attribute (migration 0014); operators must apply FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY to their own tables

provisioning.apply: forge migrate applies the SQL migrations directory (no separate plan subcommand exists; review migration files before applying)
provisioning.tokenMint: forge token mint creates operator JWTs

audit.surface: AuthzAuditRecord decisions (allow/deny/step-up) written by the middleware pipeline; shadow mode logs the deny but lets the request pass

restartSemantics.gateCaches: in-process (moka) with LISTEN/NOTIFY invalidation and optional Redis L2; a restart starts cold, so JWKS and route config are refetched
restartSemantics.clientResume: after reconnect, subscriptions resume from the last checkpoint at fromOffset = lastSeen + 1
